<thought>We need to retrieve the retrosynthetic template that matches the SNAr transformation for the target molecule and then apply it to obtain the exact precursor SMILES. The catalog search returned a matching entry with reaction_id 1118219. Using this integer as the template identifier with `get_template` will fetch the template, after which `apply_template` can be used on the target SMILES to generate the precursor list.</thought>
<action>get_template</action>
<action_input>{
    "template_id": 1118219
}
